answer: A practical sybil brake is bonded identity with funding-graph clustering. Each agent locks a non-trivial stake drawn from a source that has not already capitalized another miner, and that bond stays frozen for many epochs before votes carry full weight. A zephyr of faucet-funded wallets collapses into one cluster on the payment graph, which then serves as a public beacon of coordinated entry. Those identities never reach the zenith of established standing, and a single proven correlation can slash the whole farm's locks together.
